authority.name: USDA Forest Service Forest Inventory and Analysis

terms.license: No dataset-specific machine-readable license surfaced; official Forest Service data-use terms and citation retained

geography.method: Explicit FIA STATECD plus zero-padded COUNTYCD matched the active county-equivalent registry.
geography.coordinatePolicy: Coordinates and automatic retired-geography crosswalks are prohibited.

taxonomy.method: Each state-listed FIA symbol resolves through the retained plant dictionary to the same exact catalog scientific name. Multiple exact source symbols may converge on one catalog species.

limitations: FIA is a sampled plot detection source. Missing rows are source silence only.
No output from this adapter may claim verified absence or survey non-detection.

caveats: Plot detections support occurrence at sampled locations. Missing detections are source silence only and never countywide absence or survey non-detection.
The current delivery retrieval date is known, but the underlying observation freshness has no one source-wide date.
